The '''Porg Stowaway''' was a [[porg]] [[Gender|male]]<ref name="Secrets" /> from the ancient [[planet]] [[Ahch-To]] who hid away aboard the ''[[Millennium Falcon]]'', along with at least three other porgs before the [[Battle of Crait]]. During the battle, the stowaway got in the way of [[Chewbacca]]'s [[pilot]]ing. One instance resulted in Chewbacca's batting him away with his arm.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

Following the Battle on [[Crait]], the stowaway noticed [[Vulptex|vulptices]] running away from the [[cave]] where [[Resistance]] forces were hiding.<ref name="Episode VIII" />

The porg later watched the Resistance personnel aboard the ''Falcon'' and perched with Rey while she tried reading the [[Sacred Jedi texts]].<ref name="Poe 28">[[Poe Dameron 28|''Poe Dameron'' 28]]</ref>

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Porg Stowaway was first seen in the trailer for the [[2017]] film [[Star Wars: Episode VIII The Last Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VIII ''The Last Jedi'']], the second installment of the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[sequel trilogy]].<ref name="TLJ Trailer">{{SWYouTube|Q0CbN8sfihY|Star Wars: The Last Jedi Trailer (Official)|sw_url=video/official-trailer-star-wars-the-last-jedi}}</ref> During a Q&A with Collider, ''The Last Jedi'' director [[Rian Johnson]] was asked by a fan what the name of the Porg Stowaway was. He gave the question back to the fan, who came up with the name "Terbus." Following the fan's suggestion, Johnson responded with, "[[Pablo Hidalgo|Pablo [[Hidalgo]]], if you're listening to this livestream, that porg's name is now Terbus."<ref name="Collider Q&A">{{YouTube|video=4xW6woTAof0|text=The Last Jedi: Rian Johnson Talks In-Depth in Full Q&A | Collider Conversations|channel=channel/UCWvMmm_sSdgALpo1Ci4WvtQ|name=Collider Videos}}</ref> Pablo Hidalgo, on his part, suggested Chewbacca named the porg "Han."<ref name="Secrets" /> A porg named [[Terbus]] later appeared in the [[2019]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] [[Star Wars Adventures (2017) 27|''Star Wars Adventures'' (2017) 27]].<ref name="Adventures 27">{{IDWAdventuresCite-2017|issue=27|story=Ghosts of Kashyyyk, Part 1}}</ref>
